info.name: Hello, I'm Chaewon!
info.about: Frontend developer crafting both sides of the screen — interactions users see, and environments developers feel. Having studied both design and engineering, I care about craft on screen and the systems behind it. I'm drawn to building not just polished interfaces, but better ways to build them: structure, automation, and the kind of tooling that makes a team's day-to-day a little less painful.

projects.name: Azure Promilia (KR) – Official Website Launch (Frontend Lead)
bullets: Owned frontend development end-to-end: tech stack selection, architecture design, and reusable component structure
Designed a BFF layer using Next.js Route Handlers for API proxying, server-side token isolation, and centralized validation
Established security audit and load testing strategy for up to 5,000 concurrent users
Streamlined cross-functional collaboration and scheduling, reducing project timeline by 50%

projects.name: Mabinogi Heroes (KR/NA) – Legacy Modernization & Automation (Frontend Lead)
bullets: Led modernization of a legacy website into a scalable React + Vite architecture with a structured dev/prod branching strategy
Introduced shared components, event templates, and automation scripts — cutting dev time by 85% and new event turnaround by 50%
Built internal dev tools to automate repetitive content operations including image path generation and HTML production, reducing manual prep time by 95%
Developed terminal-based scripts to automate the full build and deployment pipeline, reducing deploy time by 80%

projects.name: Interactive Global Web Campaigns
bullets: Built and optimized a Three.js 3D gallery rendering 162 image panels — reduced GPU memory via geometry instancing (162 VBOs → 1) and stabilized scroll navigation through input debouncing
Introduced an image optimization pipeline across all web event projects, cutting file sizes by 50% and load time from 3s to under 1s
Built character introduction slides, map drag interactions, and other content interactions for Azure Promilia pre-registration
Delivered multilingual, in-game integrated web events for KR and NA audiences across Mabinogi Heroes, Blue Archive, and KartRider Rush+
